# Kamboh Associates
> FBR-registered tax consultancy in Lahore, Pakistan. Specialising in income tax filing, NTN registration, SECP company formation, sales tax returns, wealth statements, and corporate tax compliance since 2008.

## About
Kamboh Associates is a Pakistan-based tax consultancy firm established in 2008. We serve individuals, salaried persons, freelancers, SMEs, and corporates across Pakistan from our Lahore office. FBR-certified consultants. WhatsApp: 0328-4675162. Address: Shop No 34 Rizwan Block Market, opposite Rizwan Park, Awan Town, Lahore 54660, Pakistan.
